what: The callback shadow gate on image p33 killed at the job's memory limit: the interpreter with torch loaded on every rank needs the memory of a torch process a rank.
outcome: the ranks were killed (forrtl: error (78): process killed (SIGTERM)) before the first step completed; the model run exited 137
bfb_record_note: no record of the run was written; the comparison the job ran anyway was discarded with it
diagnosis: 512 interpreters each importing torch and loading the TorchScript model, on top of the model's own memory, exceed the fifty-step job's 64 GB a node; the month jobs ask 200 GB a node and ran.
disposition: Rerun at 200 GB a node: 7511790, bit for bit, 51 200 calls answered by the callback in shadow.
